label: GO step, choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial that ended in S2 (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), almost exclusively when the policy picks a2 (95% of mass on model_act==2, choice logit strongly negative) and the previous trial was a2->S2 common (prev_state==1 nearly silences it). Strongest activations: previous trial unrewarded (r0 shown at D1) and the agent stays on a2; weaker activations when previous was rewarded. Dies out late in the episode (none after ep_trial ~75) and is concentrated in the value range 7.7-8.1. Recorded predicate is precise (dev P 0.75, mass recall 0.71) but misses the many weak a2-after-reward activations; the broader (phase==GO)&(model_act==2)&(prev_state!=1)&(ep_trial<60) gets mass recall 0.91 but precision 0.36. prev_state!=1 includes the window first trial where prev is unknown. Uses only observed variables plus the model own current action.
